title: Welcome to ZeXis
description: A fast, modern, and privacy-respecting Linux desktop experience. Let's take a quick tour of what makes ZeXis special.

title: Everything You Need
description: ZeXis comes pre-loaded with a curated set of applications — a web browser, office suite, media player, and developer tools — ready to use from day one.

title: Your Privacy, Protected
description: ZeXis ships with sensible privacy defaults. No telemetry is collected without your consent, and all updates are signed and verified.

title: Always Up to Date
description: The ZeXis Software Center makes installing, updating, and removing software simple. Automatic security updates keep you protected in the background.

title: Join the Community
description: Got questions? Our forums, wiki, and chat rooms are staffed by friendly community members and developers ready to help you get the most out of ZeXis.

title: You're All Set!
description: That's everything you need to know to get started. We hope you enjoy ZeXis — built with care, by the community, for everyone.
